description: This file is a shell script containing a series of test cases for the 'git checkout --orphan' functionality, used to verify various behaviors and edge cases of creating orphan branches in Git.

methods.name: test_expect_success
methods.description: Defines a test case expecting success, runs the provided commands, and verifies the expected outcome.

methods.name: test_must_fail
methods.description: Runs a command expecting it to fail; verifies that the command does not succeed.

methods.name: test_cmp_config
methods.description: Compares Git configuration variables for expected values.

methods.name: test_cmp
methods.description: Compares output of commands or files for equality.

methods.name: test_tick
methods.description: Advances Git's internal timestamp or clock for deterministic testing.

methods.name: test_done
methods.description: Marks the end of the test script.
